name: audit-review-nested-check-falseblock
title: Fix sd-review coordinator nested-check false-block
description: The sd-review coordinator (scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review.py) reproducibly reports knowledge.obsidian-kb and pack.review-scope as failing when both pass in every direct check.py invocation, blocking the post-finalization successor-head review. Diagnose the direct-vs-nested divergence, make the nested check observe the same state a direct invocation does without weakening either check, and add a regression test that reproduces the pre-fix divergence.
